entity: BF Borgers' (Ben Borgers') former public-company clients
what_we_add: 27 ex-clients moved to four Nigerian audit firms; the 218 base split into 143 re-audited (54 one-partner, 72 two-to-five-partner, 17 bigger firms) and 75 with no later audit
why: Bloomberg Tax: nearly 40% of ~180 Borgers clients had no new auditor by June 2024; Accounting Today: 125 ex-clients landed at new, mostly small firms in Q2 2024. Same finding, same direction, no claim more than 25% off (75/218 = 34% vs ~40%; 218 vs ~180 is 21% and a different client definition); nobody mentions the Nigerian firms or the partner-size split.
